scope.title: Build the brand visibility filter

notes.label: Preserve tenant isolation
notes.detail: The tenant constraint remains outside the alternative brand grants.

notes.label: Accept any of three grants
notes.detail: Department, team or individual grant can confer visibility. Missing membership clauses are omitted. Token refresh updates these claims; this does not grant permission to act on an unclaimed pool.

ingestion.title: Read an incoming-message write path

notes.label: Check the provider ID
notes.detail: A repeated provider message can return the existing record. This early read is a convenience, not an atomic lock.

notes.label: Update the inbox preview
notes.detail: This write can increment unread state before Message.create succeeds. It is a separate database operation.

notes.label: Choose the episode
notes.detail: The latest episode and message direction determine whether to continue or create a session.

notes.label: Persist the message
notes.detail: Store references to conversation and session plus the provider identity. The sparse unique mid index rejects duplicate IDs.

notes.label: Apply status rules after persistence
notes.detail: onMessageStored applies reopen rules and synchronizes SLA. Reload the conversation when status changes or a session opens, so message:new carries the new episode’s assignment summary.

notes.label: Notify the room
notes.detail: Persistence happens before the event. The transport is Socket.IO in the API or Redis emitter in the worker.

settings.title: Understand optimistic configuration saves

notes.label: Read the current version
notes.detail: Load the latest saved setting for this scope and type. An unsaved setting has virtual version zero.

notes.label: Detect a stale editor
notes.detail: A caller must save against the version it read. A mismatch is a conflict, so the editor should reload rather than overwrite.

notes.label: Append a version
notes.detail: Select the discriminator model for the setting type. Insert a new record instead of updating the previous one.

notes.label: Advance the version
notes.detail: The unique scope/type/version index arbitrates simultaneous writers. History is retained in the same collection.

notes.label: Handle a race
notes.detail: Two callers may both read the same current value. Translate the losing insert into a 409 conflict.
